summary.text: Trojan whom Atreus' son Agamemnon slew with his sharp spear when the king leapt among the press — distinct from Thoön son of Phaenops whom Diomedes slew and from other Homeric namesakes.

story.text: When the Trojans pressed hard upon the Achaeans, Agamemnon first smote peerless Deïopites from above in the shoulder; and thereafter he slew Thoön and Eunomus, and then Chersidamas as he leapt down from his car.
